## 1. Soul Pyre’s missing Ready concentration save — confirmed

The accepted Ready contract keeps the held spell concentrated **through resolution**. The caster’s **32 damage** therefore requires the actual **CON DC16** check before end-of-resolution cleanup. The earlier case omitted it.

The corrected main case supplies **14 + 2 = 16**, success. The independent new branch, **`RD8-03-B-CONCENTRATION-FAIL`**, supplies **13 + 2 = 15**, failure.

| State | Passing main case | New failure branch |
|---|---|---|
| Caster damage and HP | 32 damage; **108→76** | Same |
| Concentration check | DC16, total16: success | DC16, total15: failure |
| Hold ending | After instantaneous resolution | **Immediately on failure**, before the later recipient |
| Carrier damage and HP | 7 fire + 8 necrotic; **108→93** | Same already-created application resolves |
| Corpse | Consumed once | Consumed once; not restored |
| Caster resources | **21 RP, Dissonance 2**, Reaction spent | Same; no refund or second payment |
| Concentration ending | Once | Once; cleanup does not end it again |

### The necessary new authorship

**`RD8-PYRE-READY-BATCH-03`** explicitly permits **Soul Pyre’s already-created instantaneous blast** to complete after its own damage ends the held concentration. It does not postpone the failure or unrelated life/concentration consequences.

The boundary is precise: losing concentration **before** the fuel-consumption/blast-creation checkpoint prevents that blast and consumes no corpse. Once that checkpoint has consumed the corpse and created the frozen recipient applications, the failure does not refund fuel, cancel or resample that blast, or create another roll, root or release.

**This does not change generic Ready or all instantaneous spells.** The full paragraph is synchronized through the Soul Pyre procedure, both chapters, spell disposition, new-authorship record and Q08/Q09 answers.

## 2. Wall cover ray — confirmed geometry defect

The original screen began at **x = 5**. The supplied valid ray from `[0,30,0]` to Hawk witness `[10,40,20]` crosses the screen’s y interval at **x = 2–4**, so it misses that screen.

The corrected real screen is:

```text
minimum: [0.5, 32, 0]
maximum: [15, 34, 25]
```

At plane **y = 33**, every base-to-point ray through the **entire supplied Hawk body** crosses within:

```text
x: [7/3, 27/7]
z: [16/3, 264/35]
```

Those complete intervals lie inside the screen. The Ram’s actual witness **`[-10,40,1]`** retains a clear negative-x ray.

The unsupported `coversHawkRelevantPaths` flag is removed. **No complete visual-occlusion claim is made or needed.** Blocked line of effect prevents Hawk admission: it remains **108 HP**, with no save, Prone or Falling. The Ram still takes **32 psychic**, ending at **76 HP**, and prevents Prone only through its actual form immunity.

## 3. Greater Dispel’s incomplete capture set — confirmed source contradiction

The complete accepted Greater Dispel procedure does not permit selective omission of an eligible co-located cloud. The revised independent fixture retains **both clouds** and resolves both generating casts.

A complete separate **Wizard15**, with actual prepared Greater Dispel, has a genuine **regular turn from 3 to 4**. It commits at **3.1**, using V/S/F, its Action and **10 RP: 56→46**.

Its source `[18,25,3]` is **25 feet** from the chosen center `[18,0,3]`, within the spell’s 30-foot range. Its body is outside the damaging clouds.

At **3.2**, before either ending, the immutable capture set contains both extant rank-eight clouds:

| Generating cast | Independent check | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| Cloud A | **17 + INT4 + PB5 = 26**, against DC26 | Whole field ends |
| Cloud B | **18 + INT4 + PB5 = 27**, against DC26 | Whole field ends |

Both linked concentration sources end. The target remains at **68 HP**; prior damage and exposure history are not refunded. No future cloud pulses remain.

No Lesser Antimagic has yet been cast in this reset. No Sigil Authority bonus, Counterspell-only Arcane Feedback, second casting payment or “uncaptured” coincident cloud is introduced. A separate diagnostic also confirms that failure against the first cast does not remove the second cast from the already captured set.

## 4. Carrier save and corpse anchor — confirmed fixture contradictions

Every affected carrier sheet now gives **STR18 its natural +4 save**, rather than zero.

The carried principal corpse consistently uses **`[10,0,2]`**, with a declared two-foot held offset from the carrier’s foot. Five feet of actual regular-turn movement carries it to **`[15,0,2]`**. Its release range is **√226 < 20 feet**.

The out-of-range branch explicitly carries it to **`[25,0,2]`**, where **√626 > 20 feet**, using 15 of the carrier’s 30 movement feet.

The real carrying quantities remain:

**150 lb corpse + 10 lb other gear = 160 lb**, within **270 lb capacity**; **8 Load**, within **18 Load capacity**.

Corpse identity, provenance, real gear and consumption behavior remain intact.

## 5. Form and progression metadata — confirmed

The correction covers **all 17 relevant form-sheet occurrences**, not only the displayed main actors.

**Hawk and Bear:** Base-form speech is unavailable; gear is melded and unusable; Druid15 has neither Beast Spells18 nor a supplied form-casting exception.

**Ironhorn Ram:** Its Arch-form speech exception remains distinct. It still cannot cast at Druid15 under these inputs.

The unused helper spell-origin coordinates are marked **nonoperative (`null`)**, rather than presented as current casting origins outside or incompatible with the actual body. Maintaining a genuinely existing concentration remains possible; no new cast or concentration is granted.

All **nine Wizard7 Anchor-sheet occurrences** now identify an **Arch Arcanist with no Hero path**. No Spellbinder feature is acquired before its actual gate.

The fire-immune Cloud branch now supplies a complete **Ashen Grove replacement**, with its actual fire grants and **without Storm lightning/thunder resistance**. Optional Blazing Rebirth and Flame Stride are not silently activated.

These changes preserve the existing target damage and posture outcomes. Later natural-body reversion restores anatomy and gear usability only then—not retroactively.

## 6. Off-turn movement — clarification repaired without inventing permission

The original movement at **7** had no supplied lawful opportunity. I did not add an off-turn movement source.

The corrected sequence uses the target’s actual **8–10 regular turn**:

| Segment | Actual movement | Budget |
|---|---|---:|
| 8.1–8.2 | Foot `[30,0,0]` → `[41,0,0]` | 11 spent; 19 remain |
| 8.3–8.4 | Foot `[41,0,0]` → `[30,0,0]` | 22 total spent; 8 remain |

At x41, the nearest body point is **x38.5**, **20.5 feet** from the cloud center: the whole body is genuinely outside. Merely touching the boundary at x38 would not establish absence.

Leaving and reentering create **no pulse or exposure reset**. Only the scheduled pulse at **12** supplies the next 35 damage, taking the target **44→9 HP**.

The separately mentioned extra turn at 10 remains **conditional on an actual external provider**, ordered after the regular END. This spell and fixture grant neither that provider nor an extra action budget.

## 7. Blocked-strain value — confirmed textual defect

The qualification now states **Dissonance 17**, matching the complete actor and changed input.

**Limit 11 + 6 = 17** bars ordinary ranked commitment without an actual exception. The supplied blocked state, no-payment result and separate surcharge example at 11 are unchanged.

## 8. Wall establishment and expiry — ambiguity explicitly resolved

This was a clarification request, not proof that only one interpretation had previously been possible. The revised fixtures select:

```text
Paid commitment:          1
Actual manifestation:     1.1
Maximum duration:         60 seconds
Nominal expiry:           61.1
Actual voluntary ending:  5
```

Commitment’s prospective concentration burden is not treated as an already manifested visual with a backdated deadline.

Both full main cases, all six branch clock records and the new-observer terminal agree. An observer at 2 can examine the still-live visual without creating damage or Prone. After the actual ending at 5, that visual is gone.

No later observation or suppression bookkeeping resets the deadline. True Seeing’s separate **deadline 58** and the actual Falling **marker 8** remain unchanged.

The revised candidate contains **12 complete main cases and 42 independent branches**. All original 12 main IDs and 41 branch IDs remain; the failed-concentration branch is additional.

The package preserves complete before/after objects for **all eight affected cases**. The other four complete main-case objects stay exact. All native spell/access envelopes, printed damage totals, ranks, schools and risk tiers remain unchanged.

The operative mirrors agree across **MODEL, CASE_DISPOSITIONS, SPELL_DISPOSITIONS, NEW_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP, QUESTION_DISPOSITIONS, PLAYER_CHAPTER and DIRECTOR_REVIEW**.
